page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a small running head "DEDICATIO." centred above the text. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: stri erga me affe-ctus argumentum, quod difficillimo anni tempore, tot, cætera, publicis districti negotiis, Lugdunum Bata-vorum invisere & coram mecum de laudabili propo-sito Tetrarchiæ Neomagensis agere volueritis. Qua extraordinaria hu-ma-

page.notes: The first word "stri" is a fragment at the top of the page; the start of the sentence is on the previous page. The word "ma-" at the foot is a catchword with a printed hyphen. Long s is transcribed as plain s. Some line-end hyphens are printed and kept.
